_about: TEST-ONLY frozen SQL extraction table of the chat check (design 5.5 CH-T5; OQ33.1-33.3 and the DEFAULT switch EXTRACT_DETAILS of make_chat_cells.py at its defaults: fences commonmark, prose_case upper-or-lower; A8-07 text). A = runner.extract_sql [sql, parse_ok, sql_present]; A_tags = pre-declared Form A tag sensitivity [sql, parse_ok, sql_present]; B = Form B rule [sql, parse_ok, extract_rule]. A runner exception is a declared parse failure with sql = the stripped reply. sql_present (the NO_SQL test of OQ33.3) is one rule for both forms: a line of the extracted text starts with SELECT, or WITH name AS (, in any letter case. Form B: a backtick run with another backtick later on its line opens an inline code span, not a fence (CommonMark); the rest of the opening line is the info string, whose first word is the tag. Expected values were written from the rules, not produced by the extractor; revised 14 Oct 2026 (one NO_SQL test, info string, inline span).
